highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia m151 and improves managed rendering and text performance.
highlights_body: It adds .NET 11 WebAssembly assets, removes allocation-heavy text helpers, and fixes an encoded-image native resource leak.

bullets.detail: Ships the m151 renderer with subsequent upstream bug-fix syncs.
SKColor hexadecimal parsing supports ReadOnlySpan<char> inputs without intermediate strings.

bullets.lead: Encoded image creation no longer leaks native resources
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData with a subset releases native resources correctly.
Provides Emscripten 5.0.6 native libraries with modern exception handling for .NET 11 WebAssembly.

bullets.lead: Managed color and text paths reduce allocations
bullets.detail: Color conversion, tag parsing, shaping results, and UTF-8 buffer input avoid unnecessary native calls and temporary allocations.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly build cleanup, modern runtime assets, and rendering support

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 finalized the m151 servicing fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added managed performance improvements, WebAssembly assets, and resource-lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzzSharp text input and tag parsing by eliminating avoidable allocations.
